$comment: SEC.1 (REQ-SPEC-30; ADR-017) — THE SYSTEM-POOL BOUNDARY. Every file listed here may reference the system-pool seams (systemExec / systemTxRunner / systemPool / systemDatabaseUrl / SYSTEM_DATABASE_URL). Everything else — user routes above all — must not touch them: eslint-plugin-rhema/no-system-pool-in-user-route enforces it and packages/security-checks pins this list so an addition is a deliberate, reviewed act. See docs/security/tenancy-audit.md for the per-path audit.

files.apps/api/src/admin-cli.ts: operator CLI — SYSTEM_DATABASE_URL only (cross-tenant support/tooling by design)
files.apps/api/src/account-export-routes.ts: CAP.3 (D-STB.5a-1; ADR-090) — the anonymous emailed-token download resolves token_sha256→row + stamps downloaded_at on systemExec: the token IS the credential (no session ⇒ no tenant GUC ⇒ the FORCE-RLS table reads empty on the user pool); unbound ⇒ 503 fail-closed
files.apps/api/src/billing-routes.ts: Stripe webhook intake writes stripe_events (system table) through systemExec
files.apps/api/src/claim-prepass.ts: proxy credential mint/revoke for the claim pre-pass — elevated seam
files.apps/api/src/index.ts: composition root — forwards systemExec into the billing deps
files.apps/api/src/server.ts: constructs the pools; passes systemExec to the audited seams
files.apps/worker/src/billing-jobs.ts: stripe-event processing, provider reconcile, balance assertion, withheld-delivery re-drive
files.apps/worker/src/export-jobs.ts: account export zip build — reads across the account's tables
files.apps/worker/src/ledger-jobs.ts: billing sweeps (parked holds, period tick) — cross-tenant
files.apps/worker/src/main.ts: pool construction; pg-boss on the system DSN; systemTxRunner wiring
files.apps/worker/src/migrate.ts: OPS.1 — the in-VPC migrate/seed entry (rhema-<stack>-migrate Cloud Run Job): migrations + ALTER ROLE … LOGIN + deployments provenance all ride the system pool by design
files.apps/worker/src/run-jobs.ts: run lifecycle handlers — provision mints via systemTxRunner
files.infra/pulumi/compute.ts: IaC wiring — emits the SYSTEM_DATABASE_URL env into the api/worker services
files.infra/pulumi/data.ts: IaC wiring — the DB urls the services' env values resolve from
files.infra/pulumi/index.ts: OPS.1 — composes the generated system DSN (postgres role) into the non-prod system-database-url SM version; mounts stay secretKeyRef-only
files.integration/src/harness.ts: integration harness binds the system seam over the test DB
files.integration/src/run-live-exit.ts: live-exit runner binds a systemExec-shaped adapter
files.packages/orchestrator/src/runspec.ts: RES.1 — reads the live proxy_credentials context->'webTools' so researchPreflight mirrors the policy the proxy enforces
files.packages/orchestrator/src/testing/deps.t: test deps bind the harness systemTxRunner
files.packages/orchestrator/src/testing/pg.ts: the test harness defines both runners
